macrostructure.name: Narrative Workflow
macrostructure.reason: Per page-structures.md §1, the brief's centre of gravity is a sequence to walk (request → use → expire), not a single artifact to inspect or a claim to read. A skeptical, workflow-literal engineering audience trusts watching one ticket's whole life more than a static specimen card, so the whole page (not just one section) is shaped as a before→during→after story, with the ticket motif carried through each stage.

thesis: A vault you have to trust once is a liability. Haven gives you a ticket instead: a torn, numbered claim check good for one secret, for a limited time, and a carbon-copy stub the ledger keeps forever. You watch the ticket get issued, watch it get used, and watch it expire on its own — the trust is in seeing the mechanism, not in a promise about encryption. Every section re-enters the same physical object — the perforated tear-line — from a different stage of its life: as the reveal control on the hero's ticket, as the connective tissue between the three lifecycle steps, and as the status mark on every row of the ledger.
signature_spatial_move: A perforated tear-line — a dashed edge broken by small circular perforation dots, like a real ticket stub — recurs three times: (1) the hero's ticket card has a perforated seam between its 'stub' (kept) and 'claim' (issued) halves, with a Tear control that visually separates them and reveals the masked secret value; (2) the lifecycle walk's three stages (Request / Use / Expire) are connected by the same perforation line drawn vertically down an alternating left-right column, not numbered circles or a straight rule; (3) the ledger-log specimen gives every row a small perforation-dot status mark (issued / used / expired) instead of a colored pill.
whitespace_strategy: Gallery-mode airiness (64–112px section gaps) in the marketing bands; the ticket card and the ledger-log block collapse to a dense 4/8px internal rhythm — the declared exception argues 'the marketing breathes, the record is exact', not an oversight.
avoided_template: The default SaaS attractor (centered hero, gradient blob, three identical feature cards, four-column footer) and the security-product cliché (a stock padlock/shield hero photo). Also deliberately avoided: arm A1's bank-vault-dial framing on the same brief (a rotating combination-lock ring device) — this build commits to a different concrete object (a torn ticket stub) and a different macrostructure (Narrative Workflow vs. Specimen) so the two independent directions do not converge.

families.display: ui-serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif — a document/ledger register for headings only
families.body: system-ui sans-serif stack — kept purely for body-copy legibility, a distinct role from the display serif
families.mono: ui-monospace / SFMono stack — used for secret keys/values, the ledger-log specimen, and expiry timestamps

type_system.ratio: 1.333 (perfect fourth), base 16px body, weight contrast 700 serif headings vs 400/500 sans body — more editorial than a plain SaaS scale, matching the ledger/document framing
type_system.rules: roman display only (no italic headings); tight negative tracking (~-0.015em) on display sizes; open 1.6 leading on body, 1.08 on display; short uppercase labels only, tracked +0.06em, never running text; body never below 16px (13px reserved for chip/metadata micro-labels only)

spacing_system.density_by_zone: airy (mid, 64–112px gaps) for marketing bands; dense (4/8px) inside the hero ticket card and the ledger-log specimen — a declared Axis-3 exception, not an inconsistency

surface_ramp: #211714 overlay-on-dark (sticky nav after scroll, CTA band)
color_system.accent: #7a2418 deep oxblood/ticket-red (~10° hue) — a ledger-stamp, ticket-stub colour, chosen outside the indigo/violet 270–330° band taste-lint's ai-cliche-gradient flags, and distinct from arm A1's brass/gold. Contrast-checked: 7.63:1 on paper, 8.35:1 on white, 8.35:1 reversed (white-on-oxblood) — all AA+.
color_system.accent_tint: #f0dcd2 pale rose-cream wash — background-only (chips, hover fills), never used for text
color_system.status_secondary: #5c5330 muted olive-brass, used only for an 'expiring soon' status mark, never as a second brand colour (6.02:1 on paper)
color_system.text: #231c15 near-black warm ink primary (16.1:1 on paper), #6b6250 muted secondary (5.14:1 on paper, 5.71:1 on white)

ramp: raised (soft oxblood-tinted shadow, no border — reserved for exactly one element: the hero ticket card)
overlay (near-solid dark tint + hairline, sticky nav only after scroll, and the CTA band)
depth_system.shadow_recipe: background-tinted (warm oxblood-grey, never pure black), single soft stop, never doubled with a heavy border on the same surface
depth_system.no_glass: no backdrop-blur anywhere; the sticky nav gains a near-solid paper tint + hairline border on scroll, so legibility never depends on blur

motion_system.entrance: sections fade+rise 8px on scroll-into-view, staggered ~50ms per child, ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 300–380ms; content is the real final CSS state and only animates if JS runs (never a visibility gate)
motion_system.interactive: hover/focus transitions 150–200ms ease-out on transform/opacity/color only, never width/height; the hero ticket's Tear control slides the stub half aside along the perforation and cross-fades the masked value to plaintext with no layout shift
motion_system.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all entrance motion to an instant static state; hover/focus transitions shorten to ~80ms but are not removed (still needed for state feedback); the tear interaction becomes an instant swap
motion_system.forbidden: no overshoot/bounce easing, no linear easing, no animated layout properties, no animating-in focus rings

icon_system.policy_note: generation-craft-defaults.md prescribes the official Phosphor package for the runtime; this is a single offline static HTML file with no build step or network access, so no package can be fetched. Deviation: hand-authored inline SVG line icons, 24x24 viewBox, uniform 1.5px stroke, round joins — matching Phosphor Regular's visual weight and grammar without the literal dependency.

imagery_plan.asset_role: atmospheric hero background texture, decorative only
imagery_plan.prompt_intent: macro texture of aged cream ledger paper with a torn perforated ticket edge and a faded oxblood ink stamp, soft directional light, visible paper fiber grain; no legible text, no numerals, no logo, no illustration style
imagery_plan.placement: confined to the hero's right-column stage, behind the ticket specimen card, at reduced opacity so it never carries copy or reduces text contrast — all text sits on solid paper/white/ink surfaces, never directly on the image
imagery_plan.essential_copy_rule: no copy or controls are baked into the image; the card and its text are live HTML layered above it

section_architecture.layout_model: sticky minimal bar: wordmark left, 3 links, CTA button right; hairline bottom border only, gains a near-solid paper tint after scroll

section_architecture.role: open the story: state the mechanism (a claim ticket, not a password) rather than a generic 'keep secrets safe' claim
section_architecture.layout_model: asymmetric 2-column (55/45): headline + lede + dual CTA left; a ticket specimen card right (masked value, scope, expiry, perforated Tear control) sitting over the ledger-paper texture image on a raised stage
section_architecture.composition_anchor: the ticket card and its perforated Tear control, whose device recurs in the next two sections
section_architecture.content_dependency: a secrets vault's hero has to show an actual ticket, not an abstract padlock — the shape follows the product

section_architecture.role: narrative walkthrough of one ticket's whole life — the page's spine, not a decorative aside
section_architecture.layout_model: Narrative Workflow — three stages (Request / Use / Expire) laid out as an alternating left-right column (stage 1 text-left/art-right, stage 2 mirrored, stage 3 mirrored again), connected top-to-bottom by one continuous perforated tear-line instead of numbered circles or a horizontal row
section_architecture.content_dependency: continues the hero specimen's story (what happens to that exact ticket); distinct from the hero via a vertical alternating rhythm instead of the hero's 2-column split

section_architecture.role: prove every issue and use is recorded by showing a real ledger, not a claim
section_architecture.layout_model: Specimen — a single full-width dense ledger block (monospace timestamps, requester, secret name, action, perforation-dot status mark) with tight line-height on a recessed surface, ruled like an accounting ledger (alternating row shading)
section_architecture.content_dependency: a security audience trusts a real log line over a claim; genuine product surface, not decorative window chrome

section_architecture.role: state the product's stance without fabricating evidence
section_architecture.layout_model: Manifesto — three short declarative statements ('Nothing standing, only issued' / 'Every ticket expires itself' / 'The stub outlives the ticket'), set large in the display serif, stacked full-width and alternating left/right text alignment rather than a 3-card grid, each followed by one short line of rationale
section_architecture.content_dependency: replaces a fabricated-metrics stat band with honest, sourceable claims about the product's own design, per page-structures.md §3; the alternating-alignment stack is structurally distinct from the hero's split and the lifecycle's alternating columns

section_architecture.layout_model: Catalogue — dense equal-weight grid of 8 named integration targets (source control, CI, cloud KMS, chat/on-call, infra-as-code), each rendered as a small ticket-stub chip with a hand-authored glyph; explicitly NOT a customer logo wall
section_architecture.content_dependency: a set of like items reads correctly as a catalogue, not a stat

section_architecture.layout_model: one large statement + dual CTA on a dark overlay band, asymmetric left-aligned, echoing the hero's alignment rather than a centered close band, with a large decorative perforated edge along the band's top seam

section_architecture.role: minimal wayfinding, deliberately not the four-column 'AI footer' tell
section_architecture.layout_model: single row: wordmark + 4 links + copyright, no social row, no link columns

structural_fingerprint_note: macrostructure=Narrative Workflow, 8 sections, focal viewport=hero (asymmetric split, ticket specimen over ledger-paper imagery), reveal=scroll-staggered entrance, nav=minimal-sticky, footer=single-row-minimal. Deliberately diverges from arm A1 on the same brief (macrostructure=Specimen, brass-dial device, offset-column principles band) on macrostructure, device, and two section layout models (lifecycle alternating-column walk, manifesto alternating-alignment stack). Recorded for future-generation diversification per page-structures.md §2.
self_declared_deviations: Icon set is hand-authored inline SVG rather than the literal Phosphor package (no network/build step available to fetch it) — matches Phosphor Regular's stroke grammar. See icon_system.policy_note.

Three type families (serif display / sans body / mono data) instead of the more common single-or-paired set — each carries a distinct, non-overlapping role (heading register, body legibility, data fidelity), which taste-rubric Axis 2 treats as a deliberate pairing rather than a collision, and matches the ledger/document framing named in the thesis.
